detail.method: wmma 16x16x16 (bf16, fp16) and 16x16x8 (tf32) with FP32 accumulate against an FP64 sum of the rounded inputs' exact products; error in FP32 ulps of the result; the inputs alternate ~1 and ~2^-18 terms so the exact sum needs more than 24 bits and the accumulate must round. A row-major (A[r*16+k]), B col-major (B[col*16+k]) loaded with load_matrix_sync, so host and device use the same elements
